javax.microedition.broadcast.purchase
Interface PurchaseListener

public interface PurchaseListener

The PurchaseListener will be notified of the purchase status. A PurchaseListener can be registered with a PurchaseObject.

Implementations use constants specified here to post the events. Applications can test the event by using "==" operator instead of String.equals() method.
